errors.problem: The Arabic is correct. Round-3 change 5 says a word glossed as clitic + word ('and you understand', 'and a star', 'and cheese') is transliterated with a hyphen, and most such words now are (wa-yadrusu, wa-khubzan, wa-ʿadas, wa-dajāj). But these words, all segged as 'and …' / 'because …', are still fused. The inconsistency even occurs within one line: day 15 reading has 'waṭaʿmiyyatan … wajubnan, wa-tashrabu'; day 18 line 5 has 'wamakarūna wa-ʿadas … wabaṣal'; day 19 line 11 has 'wa-dajāj wakhuḍār'. notes.note: الْأُسْتَاذ كَرِيم is transliterated 'Al-ustādh karīm' with a lower-case name, and the speaker tap lists 'generous' first. Similarly 'miṣr' is lower-case while 'Lubnān' is capitalised (day 14). Cosmetic.
فَضْلِكِ=your kindness (to a woman) lacks the ': 'please'' that the masculine فَضْلِكَ has; on the quiz whose answer is 'please' to a woman this would help.
مَاءً=water still has no '(object)' label, unlike شَايًا / بَارِدًا (round-2 note, unchanged).
أَقْلَام=pen (plural) and بُيُوت=house, home (plural) next to كُتُب=books, صُحُون=plates: 'pens', 'houses' would be clearer (round-1/2 note, unchanged).

لَيْسَ + present verb (لَيْسَ يَتَكَلَّمُ) is attested in Classical Arabic, though rare in modern MSA; marking it 'wrong' for beginners is fine, but the why could say 'use lā' rather than imply it is impossible.
Sukun on a final waw (الْعَفْوْ، حُلْوْ, also شَايْ in day 16) is unusual in fully vocalised text but harmless (pause).

summary: I read all 2,866 lines of days 11-20 and checked every Arabic string: 544 lines with a ⟶ transliteration, covering sentences, mistakes pairs, dialogues, readings, titles, culture notes and quiz options. For each I checked harakat, case endings (objects in -an, idāfa, after prepositions, after لٰكِنَّ, VSO with singular verbs), the present-tense prefixes and suffixes (-īna, -ūna, dual -āni), number–noun polarity (سَبْعَة أَشْخَاص/صُحُون/أَكْوَاب, سَبْعَ مَلَاعِق/شُوَك, عَشَرَة أَرْغِفَة, ثَلَاثَة أَكْوَاب, عَشْر كَلِمَات: all correct), colour agreement, the feminine-singular agreement of plurals of things, and the duals (عَطْشَانَانِ, مُخْتَلِفَيْنِ, تُرِيدَانِ, تَفَضَّلَا: correct). I also checked all 1,721 seg glosses, all 643 tap glosses, every translation and literal, all 70 quiz answer keys and every mistakes right/wrong pair. All round-2 findings are fixed: the day-20 intro and mistake note now say 'as the object of a verb', the طَبَّاخِينَ tap is correct, the present-tense prefixes تَ/يَ/نَ/يَـ have prefix glosses, and مَحْشِيّ has its shadda. I found no wrong Arabic, agreement, verb form, translation, answer key or grammar rule. Errors: 2, both minor. (1) A gloss leak: the app-wide tap gloss for عَلِي now carries the day-81 sense 'Muhammad Ali ruled Egypt' on the dessert أُمّ عَلِي in day 18 (3 tap glosses wrong out of 643). (2) An engine inconsistency: 13 words glossed 'and …' are still transliterated without the clitic hyphen (watafhamu, wanajma, wajubnan …), sometimes next to hyphenated ones in the same line. Arabic strings wrong: 0 of 544.
